<<On Path Of A Milk Delivery Round This Season>>

This season's milk delivery round follows a carefully planned route to ensure all community members receive fresh, high-quality milk. The round begins at the local community center, where the delivery team gathers to review the schedule and confirm the route. The delivery vehicle then heads to each of the 12 designated households in the neighborhood, following a route that minimizes travel time and maximizes coverage. Each stop is checked for delivery, and the milk is stored in a designated area to maintain freshness. The round concludes with a final check at the community center, where the team shares updates and answers questions. This season's delivery round is a vital part of the community's wellness program, ensuring that every family has access to nutritious milk.
